# CANDIDATE: FLAT_RIBBON_FILTER_N3

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After a period of consolidation where the EMA ribbon is flat (spread < 30 cents), the subsequent breakout has a higher probability of trending. Avoiding entries during flat ribbon conditions reduces losses in choppy markets and increases edge capture on trending days like J's winner days.

## Mechanism

Define a flat-ribbon tick as a 3-minute bar where the EMA ribbon spread (Slow EMA - Fast EMA) < $0.30. If the last N consecutive bars are all flat-ribbon ticks, block any new entry. Test N=2,3,4 in Stage-1 backtest and select the N that maximizes edge_capture on J days. Exit logic remains unchanged (chart stop, chandelier profit-lock, premium stop, time stop).

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account ~= 14% headline P&L (per OP-20 disclosure #1).
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 backtest uses N=16 months (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) of 3-min SPY bars with real OPRA fills. Selection method: brute-force scan over N=2,3,4. Overfit risk: medium (3 parameters tested, but anchored to J days via OP-16).
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not yet conducted).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J days validation not yet performed).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: 5/04 extreme vol may see reduced runner profits if filter triggers too early; max drawdown scenario: prolonged flat ribbon during trending market causes missed entries; blow-up scenario: false breakout after flat ribbon leads to whipsaw losses.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (if top-5 days = X% of P&L, state X after backtest).
